title: Service hub dashboards and public wording
summary: APES CIC, Shelter and Rescue, and Pet Care Clinic hub pages are now service dashboards with friendly public wording, open-item attention, numeric support-service totals, quick links, and recent updates.
changes: Replaced member-visible sub-core and module jargon on service hub pages with support service and support tool wording.
Redesigned each service hub as a spaced dashboard showing what needs attention, available support services with totals, permission-aware quick links, and recent updates.
Scoped hub attention and summary data to the active service while reusing the existing dashboard providers and privacy model.
affected_areas: APES CIC, Shelter and Rescue, and Pet Care Clinic hub pages
Spike mascot tips on service hub routes
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release adding richer service hub dashboards and clearer public-facing language without changing routes, permissions, or record data.
validation: ModuleProviderContractTest feature coverage for hub dashboards, scoped attention, public wording, and existing hub privacy behavior.
known_limitations: Quick create links route to existing index pages where inline create forms already live; dedicated create shortcuts are not added.
Historical Change Log release notes retain earlier internal terminology.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, service hub Blade and CSS changes, dashboard service scoping, mascot tip copy, and related feature assertions. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the service hub dashboard and public wording work for MyAPES Account issue #83.
